Technical requirements / POC scope:

- Model preferences: open 7B-13B family for cost; fallbacks to larger model only for high-value flows. Need explicit routing/fallback policy.

Cost-optimization workshop agenda (expected outcomes):

- Batching strategy: evaluate continuous batching for embeddings + async rerank batch windows; target increase batch size without violating latency SLO.
- Caching: prefix/KV cache for conversation context — measure hit-rate uplift and token savings.
- Quantization profiles: test INT8 and AWQ profiles on candidate models, measure top-n accuracy hit for reranking. CTO quote: "We can tolerate small quality delta as long as rank-stability is preserved."
- Unit economics: compute $/1M tokens for hosted vs dedicated (committed) and project 12-month spend with batching/caching applied. Finance wants "break-even commit" number.
- Deliverable: recommended batching/caching config, quantization profile with accuracy/loss matrix, predicted monthly spend under each scenario.

POC success criteria (customer):
- Average token spend reduced >=20% from naive baseline via batching/caching.
- Rerank MAP drop <= 1.5% with chosen quantization profile.
- Peak p95 latency <= 200ms under 90th percentile traffic patterns.
- Clear committed pricing proposal for Dedicated (monthly commit + burst).
